instrumentation: Ephemeral init observers wrap Storage mutations and IndexedDB object-store writes without changing arguments/results. A context binding retains bounded mutation/lifecycle metadata across reload. A separate task-owned preview serves unchanged frozen runtime with fixture credentials and public,max-age=0,must-revalidate headers. No Playwright routing is installed; a minimal away page is served by this test-only server.
limitations: Reload is not browser discard; no actual discard is claimed.
BFCache is proved only by pageshow.persisted=true and the original document identity; failed admission is reported separately.

Solo explicitly suspends Demo on pagehide, including persisted history navigation, in inherited upstream app.mjs behavior. A paused watching return documents that policy; it does not prove preservation of playing intent through freeze/resume.
Fresh ephemeral test profiles exercise ordinary entry and compare a control reload. This does not replay every possible saved-game recovery state.
Read/write observers detect API calls, not every browser-internal storage mechanism. Existing persistence and saved-flight tests remain complementary.

Background managed-media asset-cache writes (game/managed-media-store.mjs) are recorded separately from player progress, saves, recovery and tuning; the ordinary app can preload those assets independently of Demo.

CPU sampling starts before first navigation and spans the unchanged Solo control/watching/practice sequence. Native full profile is retained up to2MiB, with bounded aggregates and clock-bracketed menu/long-task interval summaries. Sampling perturbs scheduling.

Observation-only copy adds bounded menu geometry, hit-test, pointer event and long-task capture around the unchanged 3000ms click. Observer overhead can perturb timing; this is diagnostic evidence, not a replacement qualification pass.

cpuClock.scope: CDP monotonic Timestamp mapped to bracketed wall time before navigation; interval boundaries have this transport uncertainty plus millisecond wall-clock resolution.
